findings.observation: The cached page displays Juu (Quest), level 5, Adventuring, Tanvu and Kojan. Details identifies Oki as starter and Juu as hand-in, in the Shang Village series. These names and links are page-specific observations; canonical client identities and historical patch are not verified.

Objectives says Find Juu on the hill to the north for more training, followed by ...Please visit Juu up this hill to the north for more training... . Description calls this a Kojan Half-elf starter area quest in Tanvu. There is no explicit kill count, item quantity or interaction mechanic. Training narrative does not establish a class restriction or ability reward.

Location prints -16529, -49889, 194 in Tanvu (-19, 6). These two coordinate contexts remain intact without units, coordinate-system conversion or a verified spawn. Lost Fishing Supplies instead prints -16408, -49970, 187; neither string is selected as a canonical Oki location.

Details lists Previous Kojuko Gluttons and Next Kojuko Manhunters, The Unforgotten. Lost Fishing Supplies lists Next Juu (Quest), so its forward link does not reciprocate this page's Previous. One prev quest disagreement is attributed to silkyvenom, without an alternate value. No disagreement query was fetched, and no enforced prerequisite chain is selected.
Coin reward 50 has no denomination. Repeatability is absent from Details, so it remains unknown. No item reward is established by this page.

The Source link names https://vanguard.fandom.com/wiki/Juu_(Quest). This review reads the archive transcription only; the original fandom body was not fetched. The source attribution is not an independent corroborating observation.
